name: stammi
description: Private Web-App für unseren Stammtisch: Kalender, faire Kasse, Chronik und Ideen.

scripts.build:artifact: SINGLE=1 VITE_PREVIEW=1 vite build && node scripts/build-artifact.mjs
scripts.check:functions: cd supabase/functions && (command -v deno >/dev/null && deno check --node-modules-dir=none --no-config act/index.ts accept-invite/index.ts || npx -y deno@2.1.4 check --node-modules-dir=none --no-config act/index.ts accept-invite/index.ts)
